tagline: 理光便携相机，1990 年发布
description: 理光于1990年推出的便携相机。配备35mm f/4.0 - 70mm f/7.6, 2X zoom, 8 elements in 7 groups。快门速度1/30 - 1/800 sec.。感光度ISO 50 - 1600 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocusing system, 14 focusing steps。

specs.镜头: 35mm f/4.0 - 70mm f/7.6, 2X zoom, 8 elements in 7 groups
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofocusing system, 14 focusing steps
specs.英文简介: The RZ-700 is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1990.
